summary: BCE Inc. furnished a Form 6-K containing only its third-quarter 2026 management's discussion and analysis, unaudited interim financial statements, Bell Canada selected summary financials, SOX-style CEO/CFO certifications, a news release and an earnings-coverage exhibit, all for the period ended September 30, 2026. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, ownership split or regulatory clock are disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly reporting package (the Canadian equivalent of a domestic 10-Q/earnings release furnished under Rule 13a-16). Nothing special-situations-related; no risk-arb angle applies.
